address: 501 Liyuan Road, Huangpu, Shanghai, China Mainland
bio: The owner hails from Zhoushan, famous for its seafood. His mother taught him how to make noodles and he started this shop over 10 years ago to bring authentic Zhoushan noodles to Shanghai. Noodle soup is typically paired with fish shipped from his hometown, such as yellow croaker braised in bean sauce or the premium deboned beltfish, available only in October and November. The delicious yellow croaker spring rolls are hugely popular....
